trigger: Morning after a tall shape entered the Henleys' unsealed house. First discovery of assimilation (enc_ch08_hollow_first).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Morning, if you can call it that. The Henleys' door hangs open. Ash drifted down the hall. No prints come out.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Stops on the porch. Hackles up from neck to tail. A growl so low you feel it in your boots.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Dale Henley is standing in the kitchen, facing the wall. It's minus ten in here. No breath fog. None.

nodes.speaker: hollow
nodes.text: Morning, neighbor. Morning, neighbor. Got any filters? Morning, neighbor.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The voice is right. The rhythm is wrong. Like a song played back by someone who heard it once.

nodes.speaker: hollow
nodes.text: Braith? Braith. Let me in. I have filters. Braith?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He turns. His neck keeps turning after his shoulders stop. His eyes catch the light flat, like theirs do.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Three rounds. It doesn't scream. It makes the sound of the Henleys' kettle. Then it's still.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You nail plywood over the door. All afternoon, from inside: 'Morning, neighbor.' At dusk, nothing.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Back home, you tell them what you saw.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: [White-faced] The page I couldn't read. Integration. They don't just take the warmth. They keep what's left.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: And use it. I didn't know it worked outside a lab. I swear to you I didn't know.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: That was Dale. That was Dale's voice. Braith. How do we know who's knocking now?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A new rule on the door, in Carly's handwriting: CHECK FOR BREATH. ASK THE DOG. NOBODY OPENS ALONE.
